_DY_README: dy is a FRACTION OF HULL HEIGHT, positive = downward. Mike gave these in pixels against the 224px hull in the 0808e render; storing the ratio means they stay correct when the ship draws at 44px in play or 128px in the launch cinematic. Do not convert these back to raw pixels.
